gemini.title: Gaeltacht Language Planning Area Boundary
gemini.abstract: Gaeltacht Language Planning Area Boundary is an authoritative dataset published by Central Statistics Office Ireland. It represents gaeltacht language planning area boundary features using multipolygon geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by Central Statistics Office Ireland as open statistics and census data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: gpa_id
columns.description: Identifier assigned by the source dataset.

columns.description: Name associated with the represented feature.

columns.name: county
columns.description: County associated with the represented administrative area.
